Start the API server with --audit-log-path=/var/log/kubernetes/audit.log, --audit-log-maxage=30, --audit-log-maxbackup=10 and --audit-log-maxsize=100, and give it an audit policy file with --audit-policy-file. On managed clusters use the audit logging setting of the provider. Ship the audit log off the node, because rotation deletes the files. |

Write an EncryptionConfiguration file with the aescbc or kms provider, start the API server with --encryption-provider-config pointing at it, then rewrite the existing secrets so etcd stores them encrypted: kubectl get secrets --all-namespaces -o json \| kubectl replace -f -. Store the config and its key safely: etcd cannot read the secrets back without them. |
